model_selection: 5fold shuffled KFold on 301 training rows only, minimum mean log RMSE; not paper-group CV
feature_set: Existing environment descriptors; no new stage features in this protocol comparison

selected_holdout.r2_note: Null if fewer than 2 records or constant observed values; small or narrow-range experiments give unstable R2

caveat: The seed42 holdout has been inspected previously; this is development benchmarking, not a new untouched final test.
external_assessment: Previously tested 17-4PH paper retained as a separate application-domain diagnostic; not used to select this model

references.basis: 1428 soil-steel current-density observations; random 80:20; RF/SVR/MLP comparison
references.difference: Different corrosion environment and target measurement protocol; performance not directly comparable

references.basis: Literature-derived MPEA corrosion data; RF/NN/KRR/LassoIC; train/test R2 averaged over 10 repetitions
references.difference: Different alloys; no GAN or synthetic outcomes used in our analysis

references.basis: 80:20 marine corrosion split; training model optimization with 5fold CV and RMSE
